track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 27: Ravandi
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Ravandi in Homayoun, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C3 and dwells most on A in Ravandi. The line peaks at E4 (332.7 Hz) at 0:44.3. It closes on D4, not the tonic (D4 → D4 → D4 → E4 → D4 → D4).
